_opis: English tooltips for terms in English posts (same keys as glosar.json, so data-term markers stay the same in both languages). Component: src/components/blog/GlossaryTips.astro
llm-vidljivost: How often ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI answers mention or link to you. Measured with prompts and GA4.
geo: Generative engine optimization: optimising so that generative search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Mode) cite you in their answers.
aeo: Answer engine optimization: optimising for direct answers, from featured snippets and AI Overviews to voice assistants.
ai-seo: The same as GEO. The name is used more often in agency proposals.
llms-txt: A file describing your website for AI tools. Google does not use it, and there is no evidence that it brings citations.
ai-overview: AI Overview: the summary Google generates above the search results, with links to sources.
ai-mode: AI Mode: Google search in the form of a conversation. Available in Croatian too since February 2026.
grounding: When AI searches the web before answering and builds the answer from the pages it finds, instead of only from what it learned in training.
fan-out: Query fan-out: AI breaks one question into several searches (often in English too) and combines the results.
citat: Citation: next to the answer, AI gives a link to your page as a source.
spomen: Mention: AI writes your company's name, with or without a link.
